estrategias.descripcion: Milpa (maize + beans) in Primera; crop residue is burned or removed and the soil stays bare in the dry season.

por_que: It is what you do today: the baseline to compare the other options.
With your weather, on average you lose 3.4 of every 10 seasons (grain < 70% of normal).
evidencia: Daily FAO-56 water balance with the real weather of 25 seasons (NASA POWER 2001–2025): typical canícula from Jul 7 to Jul 27.
Monte Carlo of 1000 sequences of 10 seasons, with uncertain planting date and soil water.

beneficios: You already know it: no extra seed, money or labor.
info_faltante: Your actual planting date and maize variety.
Your soil depth and texture (we used typical values for the area).
riesgos: Flowering often falls in the canícula: check with your extension agent whether to shift planting.
Bare soil ~266 days a year: hillside erosion and organic matter loss (4.1% → 3.6% in 5 years, approx.).

estrategias.descripcion: Milpa (maize + beans) in Primera and beans relay-planted when the maize is doubled over; half of the residue stays on the soil.

por_que: Uses the Postrera rains (from Aug 10) with beans: if Primera fails, there is still a harvest.
Cuts lost seasons from 3.4 to 2.6 of every 10.
evidencia: Daily FAO-56 water balance with the real weather of 25 seasons (NASA POWER 2001–2025): typical canícula from Jul 7 to Jul 27.
Monte Carlo of 1000 sequences of 10 seasons, with uncertain planting date and soil water.
Postrera onset computed year by year with the Sivakumar (1988) rule; Postrera beans: 7 qq/mz typical.
Relay beans or sorghum in Postrera is common practice in eastern Guatemala (MAGA; FAO Dry Corridor).
beneficios: More food: 35 qq/mz in total (range 15–44) and a second harvest to sell.
Less bare soil: 153 fewer days a year; erosion ≈ 44 t/ha/yr less.
Beans fix nitrogen and break maize pest cycles.
info_faltante: Local price of beans or sorghum and access to seed.
Whether your land holds moisture in September (very thin soils dry fast).
riesgos: Dry Postrera in El Niño years: with El Niño, sorghum is safer than beans.
More work in September, right when you double the maize.
Bean pests and diseases in heavy rain: check with the extension agent.

estrategias.descripcion: Milpa (maize + beans) in Primera and velvet bean (mucuna) planted ~50 days later; no burning: the cover and residue protect the soil all year.

por_que: The velvet bean (mucuna) covers the soil almost all year: less evaporation and more water soaking in (runoff 40 → 13 mm).
It protects the soil the most: erosion ≈ 3 t/ha/yr (vs 52 today) and organic matter -0.20 points in 5 years.
evidencia: Daily FAO-56 water balance with the real weather of 25 seasons (NASA POWER 2001–2025): typical canícula from Jul 7 to Jul 27.
Monte Carlo of 1000 sequences of 10 seasons, with uncertain planting date and soil water.
Velvet-bean green-manure systems on hillsides of Honduras and Guatemala (Buckles et al. 1998, CIMMYT/IDRC; Bunch 2003).
Mulch effect on evaporation per FAO-56 ch. 7; erosion with RUSLE (Renard et al. 1997).
beneficios: Fixes nitrogen: maize yield can rise over the years (up to +15%, approx.); typical harvest 30 qq/mz.
Bare soil: only ~9 days a year (vs 266 today).
Fewer weeds and no burning needed.
info_faltante: Where to get velvet bean (mucuna) seed and how much.
How much biomass the cover reaches on your land (we estimate it with the water balance).
Whether free-roaming livestock will eat the cover in the dry season.
riesgos: Competes with maize for water if planted too early: sow it after the first weeding.
Velvet bean seed is not edible without processing (it contains L-dopa).
Soil benefits take 2–3 years to show; try it on a small plot first.

incertidumbre: Data for a ~50 km zone (not your exact plot). Ranges go from the 10% to the 90% of 10000 simulated seasons. Yield can vary ±30–50%: compare options, we do not promise quintales. In El Niño years ([2002 2004 2009 2015 2023]) today you lose 6.0 of every 10 seasons; in other years, 2.6. El Niño is active now (ONI 2.5, ASO 2026).

ia_vs_estadistica.nota: AI: logistic regression on 4 inputs known at planting (ONI AMJ, rain Apr 15–May 31 (z), root-zone wetness GWETROOT May (z), Tmax Apr–May (z)) trained on 825 seasons (33 NASA POWER zones × 2001–2025). Statistics: loss frequency by zone and El Niño state. Leave-one-year-out validation: Brier error AI 0.154 vs statistics 0.161 (lower is better) → here the AI model wins. Probability of losing next Primera if El Niño persists at planting: both are shown; the engine uses statistics.

confianza.habilidad: acertó la temporada en 10 de 25 años (40 % vs 33 % al azar) · pérdida: Brier 0.257 vs 0.236 · detectó 5 de 8 sequías documentadas · Brier IA 0.154 vs estadística 0.161
confianza.texto: Los primeros 16 días son el pronóstico; el resto repite 2024, el año más representativo de los parecidos al pronóstico estacional (ECMWF SEAS5) y a El Niño pronosticado. Para la milpa de siempre se espera una temporada buena (53 % de probabilidad; en 9 de 24 años pasó algo así). Con esta estrategia: cosecha probable 16–46 qq/mz, riesgo de perderla 11 %. Confianza baja.
confianza.texto_en: The first 16 days are the forecast; the rest replays 2024, the most representative year among those resembling the seasonal forecast (ECMWF SEAS5) and the forecast El Niño. For the usual milpa, expect a good season (53% probability; it happened in 9 of 24 years). With this strategy: likely harvest 16–46 qq/mz, 11% risk of losing it. Confidence low.

confianza.regla: Puntos: probabilidad del escenario ≥ 60 % → 2 (≥ 40 % → 1); validación local con ≥ 60 % de sequías documentadas detectadas → 1; temporada armada con pronóstico (o clima observado) → 1; rango de cosecha estrecho ((P90−P10)/P50 ≤ 0.5) → 1. alta ≥ 4, media 2–3, baja ≤ 1. Clima observado = alta; escenarios CMIP6 a 2040 como máximo media; nunca por encima del nivel medido en el hindcast 2001–2025 del lugar (static/validacion/habilidad.json).

siembra.texto: Sembrá el 22 abr y cosechás cerca del 15 ago (115 días). Es la fecha con menos riesgo de la ventana: pérdida 1 de cada 10 temporadas parecidas, cosecha típica 43 qq/mz.
siembra.texto_en: Sow on Apr 22 and harvest around Aug 15 (115 days). It is the lowest-risk date in the window: loss in 1 of 10 similar seasons, typical harvest 43 qq/mz.

razones.texto: Falso inicio: en 8 de cada 10 años parecidos vino una racha de 7+ días secos en el primer mes después de sembrar el 22 abr (la semilla nace y se seca).
razones.texto_en: False start: in 8 of 10 similar years a 7+ day dry spell came in the first month after sowing on Apr 22 (seedlings emerge and dry out).

razones.texto: Lluvia en la cosecha (cerca del 15 ago): 166 mm en promedio; en 6 de cada 10 años más de 150 mm (mazorca que se pudre, secado difícil).
razones.texto_en: Rain at harvest (around Aug 15): 166 mm on average; in 6 of 10 years over 150 mm (ear rot, hard drying).

razones.texto: Floración cerca del 9 jun: en 0 de cada 10 años una racha seca de 8+ días le cae encima (la floración es la etapa que más pierde grano sin agua).
razones.texto_en: Flowering around Jun 9: in 0 of 10 years an 8+ day dry spell hits it (flowering loses the most grain without water).

razones.texto: Sin heladas ni noches frías (Tmín ≤ 8 °C) en el ciclo en los años parecidos.
razones.texto_en: No frost or cold nights (Tmin ≤ 8 °C) during the cycle in similar years.

razones.texto: Sequía: al cultivo le faltan en promedio 31 mm de agua en el ciclo; pérdida en 1 de cada 10 temporadas parecidas.
razones.texto_en: Drought: the crop lacks 31 mm of water on average over the cycle; loss in 1 of 10 similar seasons.
